caption: The drawing depicts a wooden drop-leaf table with an oval top. The table has two drop leaves hanging on each side and is supported by four turned legs, which are slender and have rounded decorative sections. The legs are connected at the base by rectangular stretchers that form a frame near the floor. The wood is uniformly colored in shades of brown, highlighting the natural grain and texture of the material. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, with a few scattered small stains, leaving the focus entirely on the detailed rendering of the table. The table is centered on the page, and the perspective shows a slight angle, allowing both the top and the supporting structure beneath to be visible.
title: Butterfly Table
